text.aria-label: Title text 'D12, MVA-only eight: injected lag-only event, -50% of capacity for 15 days (pass 14) Only the lag inputs carry the shift; the observed power (orange) is the normal running arrangement (black dashed, same line). Dark band: q05-q95. Light band: q01-q99. Grey shade: the injected shift in the lags. Coloured strips: origin days in event mode (C2's gate).'
text.tspan: D12, MVA-only eight: injected lag-only event, -50% of capacity for 15 days (pass 14)
Only the lag inputs carry the shift; the observed power (orange) is the normal running arrangement (black dashed, same line).
Dark band: q05-q95. Light band: q01-q99. Grey shade: the injected shift in the lags. Coloured strips: origin days in event mode (C2's gate).
